prompt: Write a SLURM batch script for a single task on one node that counts the characters in the text café naïve (10 characters, no trailing newline) and prints the count prefixed by 'CHARS='. The count must be characters and not bytes, and it must come out the same whichever coreutils implementation the compute node ships. Request 10 minutes of walltime and 256MB of memory, and print ANVIL_OK.
